notes: Rules are checked in array order; the first matching path_prefix wins for a given changed file. A change set touching multiple prefixes accumulates the union of matched targeted_tests and takes the highest-risk matched lane. A changed file matching no rule falls back to the 'fallback' entry (full suite required, HIGH_RISK) rather than silently running nothing. DEVX-1: ID Auto rules are dependency-derived from the reference require graph (api.js -> db/identity/storage/writes; writes.js -> db/storage) and from each suite own imports. Matching is FIRST-MATCH-WINS in array order, so any file-specific rule must stay ABOVE the general prefix rule that would otherwise swallow it. (The projects/idauto rules this note once ordered were removed with the tree by IDA-DECOUPLE-4.)
